tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Tenderer shall furnish, as part of his Tender, an Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) amount of Rs. 4,43,943/- (Rs. Four Lakhs Forty Three Thousand Nine Hundred and Forty Three only) as detailed in tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer shall be individual Proprietorship firm or partnership firm or Company Registered under Companies Act 1956/2013 for tendered/similar material. Tenderer should have been registered with the Director of Industries & Commerce, Govt. of Karnataka as a Micro & Small Enterprises (MSE) under Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006 (Central Act 27 of 2006) for Manufacture of tendered/similar material. Micro & Small Enterprises shall upload valid MSME (UDYAM) registration certificate obtained from the competent authority certifying that tenderer is a Micro and Small Enterprises for Manufacture of tendered/similar material. For Proprietorship firm, PAN and GST Registration Certificate shall be uploaded.

The Tenderer shall be Manufacturer/ Authorized Dealer of material specified in the tender and shall have a minimum experience of 3 Financial Years in supply of material of same type specified in the tender as on the date of bid submission. Purchase order demonstrating experience of minimum 3 Financial Years as Manufacturer/authorized dealer of material of the same type specified in the tender, shall be uploaded. In case of Authorized dealer authorization certificate/letter from the OEM shall be uploaded along with the purchase orders in the name of authorized dealer.

The manufacturer should have Manufactured and supplied at least 40% and in case of authorized dealer should have supplied at least 40% of the tendered quantity of material of same type specified in the tender in any one of the 3 Financial Years (i.e., 2022-23 2023-24 and 2024-25 OR 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) to ESCOMs/ Distribution companies or any Government Utilities/ PSUs. In case of manufacturer, Purchase Orders and order completion certificates issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent officer of the concerned ESCOMs/ Distribution Companies or any Government Utilities / PSUs shall be uploaded. In case of an Authorized dealer, the Purchase Orders and order completion certificates issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent officer of the concerned ESCOMs/ Distribution Companies or any Government Utilities / PSUs shall be uploaded. In case of an Authorized dealer, the Purchase Orders and Order completion certificate issued in the name of manufacturer shall not be accepted to establish the eligibility of the authorized dealer. Micro & Small Enterprises shall upload valid MSME (UDYAM) registration certificate obtained from the competent authority certifying that tenderer is a Micro and Small Enterprises.

The Tenderer shall upload performance certificate for satisfactory operation of at least 40% quantity of tendered material specified in the tender for a period of at least one year in any one of the 3 Financial Years (i.e., 2022-23 2023-24 and 2024-25 OR 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) to ESCOMs/ Distribution companies or any Government Utilities/ PSUs. The manufacturer shall upload Performance certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent officer of the concerned ESCOMs/ Distribution Companies or any Government Utilities / PSUs. In case of an Authorized dealer, the Performance certificate shall be in the name of authorized dealer for supplies executed by the authorized dealer. Performance certificate issued in the name of manufacturer shall not be accepted to establish the eligibility of the authorized dealer. The authorized dealer shall upload the Performance certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent officer of the concerned ESCOMs/ Distribution Companies or any Government Utilities / PSUs.

The Average Annual Financial Turnover of the Tenderer shall not be less than 50% of the Amount Put to Tender during the 3 Financial Years (i.e. (2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25) OR (2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26)). The audited balance sheets (including profit and loss account sheet) signed by CAs with UDIN and signed by the authorized signatory of the firm for each of the financial year (i.e., (2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25) OR (2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26)) shall be scanned and uploaded.

The Liquid Assets as on last date of previous month of tender inviting date or at a later date before submission of the bid consisting of Cash at Bank plus Term Deposits plus availability of fund based credit facilities in any Nationalized/ scheduled Bank shall not be less than 12.5% of the amount put to tender. The cash at bank, term deposits and availability of fund based credit facilities shall be supported by a certificate issued by Nationalized/ scheduled Bank shall be uploaded in the sample format Annexure. If the Tenderer has banking with more than one Bank, then the available liquid assets mentioned above on a particular date i.e., as on last date of previous month of tender inviting date or any date before submission of tender shall be the same date for all the banks. In case of Fund based credit facility, the certificate issued by the Nationalized/ Scheduled Bank duly mentioning sanctioned limits, funds utilized so far and balance available as on last date of previous month of tender inviting date or at a later date, before submission of the bid shall be uploaded.

Any Tenderer from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the Tenderer is registered with the Competent Authority. A certificate for having read the clauses specified in Section-XVI of the tender documents under the heading Eligibility clauses in respect of restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer of a country which shares a land border with India shall be uploaded by the Tenderer in the following format i)I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer of a country which shares a land border with India I certify that this Tenderer is not from such a country or, if from such a country, has been registered with the Competent Authority. I hereby certify that this Tenderer, fulfills all requirements in this regard and is eligible to be considered. (Where applicable, evidence of valid registration by the Competent Authority shall be attached/ uploaded.) ii)I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer/vendor having Transfer of Technology (ToT) arrangement. I certify that this Tenderer/vendor does not have any ToT arrangement requiring registration with the competent authority. OR I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer having Transfer of Technology (ToT) arrangement. I certify that this Tenderer has valid registration to participate in this procurement.Registration certificate issued by the competent authority shall be uploaded. Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- in the prescribed format shall be uploaded.

The Tenderer should not have been DEFAULTED in supplies against Purchase Orders placed by any ESCOMs/Distribution companies or any Government Electrical Utilities/ PSUs.Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- by the Tenderer adhering to this clause shall be uploaded.

The Tenderer should not be under order of Debarment/ Blacklisting from participating in a Tender by any ESCOMs/Distribution companies or any Government Electrical Utilities/ PSUs, as on the last date of submission of bids. Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- by the Tenderer adhering to this clause shall be uploaded.

Litigation History: The Tenderer should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the preceding five years, A consistent history of awards involving litigation against the Tenderer or any partner may result in rejection of Bid. Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded.

The Tenderer should have valid Bureau of Indian Standard Certification for the PVC wire. Valid BIS certificates for tendered material issued by the Govt. of India shall be uploaded. In case of Authorized dealer the BIS certificate shall be in the name of authorized dealer.
The Tenderer shall upload GTPs for the PVC wire failing which the bid document is liable for rejection. GTP shall be uploaded.

The Tenderer shall upload the type test certificates for having conducted all the type tests mentioned in the relevant IS/technical specification on the tendered PVC wire at CPRI/ERDA/ NABL accredited Government labs/ NABL accredited Government testing centres & such type test reports shall not be older than five years as on the last date of bid submission. The type test reports from other than CPRI/ERDA/ NABL accredited Government labs/ NABL accredited Government testing centres shall not be considered and such bids will be treated as Non-Responsive. Valid type test certificates from CPRI/ERDA/NABL accredited Government labs/ NABL accredited Government testing centres shall be uploaded. In case of Authorized dealer the type test certificates shall be in the name of authorized dealer.
